description: Power management implementation for CC13x2x7/CC26x2x7 SoC in Zephyr OS, including power state transitions, initialization, and pin unlatching after shutdown.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the power management state, handling transitions to suspend, standby, or shutdown.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Handles post-exit activities after waking up from low power modes.

methods.name: power_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the TI Power module during system startup.

methods.name: unlatch_pins
methods.description: Unlatches IO pins after waking from shutdown to restore normal operation.

methods.description: Empty function placeholder for disabling scheduler during power management.

methods.name: PowerCC26XX_schedulerRestore
